definition: very careful and attentive to detail
example_sentence: The analyst performed a meticulous review of the specification.

definition: to make a process simpler and more efficient
example_sentence: We should streamline the review workflow.

definition: an important stage or point of progress
example_sentence: The team completed the first milestone on schedule.

definition: to complete an action or commitment
example_sentence: Please follow through on the agreed action items.

definition: the ability to follow a link or history between related items
example_sentence: Requirement traceability connects a business need to its test case.

definition: having more than one possible meaning
example_sentence: The requirement was ambiguous and needed clarification.

definition: a conclusion reached from evidence and reasoning
example_sentence: An inference should not be presented as a verified requirement.

definition: a prioritised list of work that remains to be done
example_sentence: The product backlog contains the upcoming user stories.

definition: an alternative action planned for an unexpected event
example_sentence: A contingency plan was prepared for integration delays.

definition: giving information clearly in a few words
example_sentence: Write a concise summary for the stakeholder meeting.
The dashboard shows project health at a glance.

definition: to make something easier to understand
example_sentence: Could you clarify the meaning of this sentence?
